title: Rica S NDE 130
content: My husband and I were living in Florida by his family. My father called and said he needed me to come home and help him (he was dying of cancer). Since my husband of fourteen years had a 'girlfriend', I left on the next plane. After several months of staying in a very small trailer and taking care of my dad, depression set in very bad. My brother had come and taken my dad to Tennessee to stay with him for the weekend. I couldn't take it any longer. I took ninety tablets. I was crying and yelled at God to forgive me. I called the hospital emergency room after about fifteen minutes and asked them if that amount would be fatal. The lady started asking me questions. I told her I didn't want her involved. But in the meantime, I guess she traced the call. After the tunnel experience, I woke up in the hospital and new exactly that it was two days later. I even knew the day of the week. The doctor came in and told me that by all rights I should not be here, that I had taken enough medication to kill ten grown men. He said I had been 'dead' for forty-five minutes and in a coma for two days.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Suicide attempt Clinical death I had taken a month's supply of my father's antidepressant medication. He was dying of cancer and I was the only one to care for him.
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes So hard to explain. There was just not a solid body.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning I'm not real sure what you mean by this.
elements.Did you pass into or through a tunnel?: Yes It was a gliding feeling. A fast glide.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes He was at the end of the tunnel. I did not know him. He had long white hair and a long white beard. I cannot remember a lot of the conversation. I have thought of being hypnotized so that I could remember, but mainly he said, 'You HAVE to go back.' As soon as he said it, I regained consciousness.
elements.The experience included: Darkness | Light | A landscape or city | Strong emotional tone | Special Knowledge | Presence of unearthly beings
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm It was a 'scene' with trees and flowers and it was full of 'moisture'. So peaceful.
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: During the tunnel, a feeling of such love and peace. Total lack of bad emotion.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control Oh, yes. What you answer for when you die is not what the preachers preach. It is, 'What have you done to help your fellow man?'
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.What is your religion now?: Moderate Still consider myself Baptist, only so much different.
elements.After the NDE: included: Presence of unearthly beings After the NDE
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes I cannot find the right words to describe very much after the tunnel. It was just so beautiful, feelings of peace and love and the 'fullness of moisture' of everything. (Not the right words.)
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: Coming back was the worst part.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes Very few. People think you're nuts.
elements.At any time in your life, has anything e: No I think about it a lot at night when I'm going to sleep, but it cannot be 'reproduced'.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: I learned that a person cannot go back if they take their own life or anyone else's.
elements.Are there any other questions that we co: Make it shorter. I've tried three times to complete this before someone came in the room wanting to know what I was doing and looking at me like I had lost my mind.
